Package io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.client

package io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.client
Draws molecules and exports media on the Minecraft client. Do not load these classes on a dedicated server.

Worked guides: custom viewers and media exports with real output. Select Java or Groovy in either guide; JSON examples cover the stored definitions and recipes.

Draw a model

Call rendering methods from a screen's drawing method or another render-thread callback. MoleculeRenderOptions lets one draw use its own camera angles, zoom, colors, and sizes without changing other views.

Export an animation

Submit an export request on the Minecraft client thread. Only one job can run at a time. For example, if molecule is a registered molecule definition: 

ExportJob job = AvogadroClientApi.exports().submit(MediaExportRequest.molecule(molecule).build());
job.onComplete(result -> {
    // Read result.state() to distinguish success, cancellation, and failure.
});

Submission can throw IOException, for example if the output file already exists. MediaExportJob.progress() can be read from any thread. Completion listeners run on the client thread after resources have been cleaned up, including listeners added after the job finished. API jobs do not send chat messages by default.
